- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:685-688 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script sets INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE=true in GITHUB_ENV unconditionally at the beginning of the review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main function.
  WHY: If the pre-push gate mode is 'off' or other conditions make the repair run skip, the variable stays 'true', so later review_autofix.yml steps gated on env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true' also skip and the whole review and autofix process is disabled. The source severity was MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this finding, judged it intentional and documented, and did not report it. minimax_minimax-m3 left it out because it is outside the last run's diff.

- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:685-688 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script sets INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE=true in GITHUB_ENV unconditionally at the beginning of the review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main function.
  WHY: If the pre-push gate mode is set to 'off' or other conditions cause the repair run to skip, the environment variable INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE remains set to 'true'. This incorrectly causes subsequent steps in the review_autofix.yml workflow (which are conditional on env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true') to skip, effectively disabling the entire review and autofix process.
